companyFieldUpdates.subsector: Formalin production and chemical pipeline infrastructure
companyFieldUpdates.description: Valentra is a U.S. Gulf Coast producer of formalin products and operator of associated chemical infrastructure. Its pipeline-connected sites in Baytown, Texas; Luling, Louisiana; and Geismar, Louisiana combine production, storage, pipelines, rail access and barge docks to supply co-located chemical plants and offsite industrial customers under large-volume, multi-year contracts. Its products support agriculture, healthcare, automotive, construction, resins, paints and coatings, consumer goods and other industrial end markets. Ancala Partners acquired the business from Hexion and formed Valentra as a standalone platform on December 4, 2025. Financial terms, Ancala's exact stake and its fund vehicle were not publicly disclosed.

set.event: Alex Mihut joined Valentra as CEO to lead its transition into a standalone platform and its future growth.
